comments_note: no. Official videos have negligible public comments: DCI GlobalNet 2, Integrated Commercial Payment Solutions 1, INTERDIN 1; Global Vision, Management Information, SalesConnect and the 2019 commercial clips report none or comments disabled.
notes: Session WebSearch budget was already exhausted (200/200) so the vimeo/conference/SlideShare/app-store sweep could not run; vimeo.com search returned 403 to WebFetch. Discovery relied on YouTube via yt-dlp plus direct page reads. Findings on surfaces: (1) Club Connections (resources.dinersclub.com) is NOT a partner portal; it is an open content hub of travel, dining and press content for cardholders and partners, no login, no tools. (2) DCI GlobalNet is the gated franchise/partner financial-reporting portal (monthly/quarterly/annual data submission); only a 58s explainer exists publicly. (3) Tracker (successor to Global Vision) is a corporate-client spend platform distributed through issuers; the 2026-04 sell sheet lists admin features (roles, permissions, impersonation, 2FA, HR imports, flat-file exports); no public demo video found. (4) File Services is named on dinersclub.com/businesses as outbound reporting for corporate customers; no media. (5) Developer route is Discover's: developer.discover.com is a login shell pointing to partner.discoverglobalnetwork.com (Discover Partner Product Portal, also a bare login); neither page mentions Diners Club publicly. (6) Issuer recruitment page on discoverglobalnetwork.com routes to mailto:DCIBrand@discover.com with no resources. (7) Support routes: servicecenter.discoverglobalnetwork.com contact form; odr.dinersclub.com is an India Online Dispute Resolution portal for failed transactions, cardholder-facing so not kept. (8) Franchise channels: Diners Club del Ecuador published a merchant-portal onboarding tutorial (INTERDIN) in 2014; its channel handle could not be resolved via @DinersClubdelEcuador or @DinersClubEcuador in the listing budget, so a full listing of Ecuador, South Africa, Hrvatska and HDFC franchise channels remains a gap. Official channel is ~95% cardholder/dining/golf content; the 2013-2014 corporate product tours (Global Vision, MIS, SalesConnect, MyDinersClub) are the only screen-level demos. Upload dates for kept YouTube items were pulled in one batch with player_client=android,web after the default client returned 'page needs to be reloaded'.
